info.name: CampusSpace API | Ayesha Mehmood FA23-BAI-010
info.description: Customized submission examples for Ayesha Mehmood, FA23-BAI-010. Run npm run seed, then execute the collection in order. Preserves established room codes and API behavior.

item.name: List free slots of ROOM-01 (filters + paging)

exec: pm.test('Only ROOM-01 slots with seats', () => body.data.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.roomCode).to.eql('ROOM-01'); pm.expect(s.booked).to.be.below(s.seats); }));
pm.test('Seats copied from room, booked = 0', () => { pm.expect(s.seats).to.eql(4); pm.expect(s.booked).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Get slot that does not exist -> 404

exec: pm.test('Booking returned', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.slotId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('freeSlotId')); pm.expect(b.roomName).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Book a slot that does not exist -> 404

exec: pm.test('Has room name, date and start hour', () => { const b = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(b).to.include.keys('roomName', 'date', 'startHour'); });
